purpose: Define how New Recruit and BSData participate in the WH40K knowledge pipeline without treating either as normative rules authority.

upstream.role: machine-readable community implementation of 11E catalogue/rules constraints

runtime.role: runtime projection of catalogue data used by players

known_drifts.summary: Trajann Valoris: current GW/MFM + mirror + BSData 265 vs New Recruit 135.
known_drifts.normative_resolution: Do not change normative KB data.
known_drifts.monitoring: Daily; exact registered drift is reported, while new/changed drift fails validation.

tooling.role: catalogue editor/validator and candidate future MCP/WebMCP validation surface

lineage: player feedback and BSData issue fixes

runtime_crosscheck: New Recruit roster validation/export where available

conflict_examples.condition: GW == Wahapedia and BSData/New Recruit differ
conflict_examples.action: Prefer GW rule fact; flag probable structured implementation/runtime bug.
Create SOURCE_CONFLICT and verify against applicable current official source.

conflict_examples.condition: BSData source != New Recruit runtime projection
conflict_examples.action: Create RUNTIME_PROJECTION_DRIFT; do not rewrite normative rules.

unknowns: Exact New Recruit polling/synchronization interval from BSData was not documented in the checked material; do not invent a cadence.
